real_issues.title: SSRF protection in MCP SSE transport is bypassable via DNS rebinding
real_issues.evidence: SSE transport validates host against allowlist but resolves hostname at connection time. An attacker controlling DNS can return 127.0.0.1 after allowlist check passes.
real_issues.impact: Local network services exposed via MCP SSE endpoints
real_issues.fix: Pin IP at allowlist check time; enforce connect-time IP matches allowed IP

real_issues.title: ConversationView cursor runner leaks on rapid tab switching
real_issues.evidence: BMessageRunner created in AttachedToWindow but never removed in DetachedFromWindow. Tab close destroys view while runner still fires messages to dead BMessenger.
real_issues.impact: Crash on tab close during streaming; memory leak per tab

real_issues.title: StreamingMarkdown reparses entire buffer on every chunk
real_issues.evidence: Append() calls Parse() which scans full accumulated buffer. O(n²) on token count. 100k token response = ~5B char comparisons.
real_issues.impact: UI jank at 500+ tokens/sec on Haiku; CPU spikes visible in ProcessController
real_issues.fix: Incremental parsing: track parser state, only process new chunk

real_issues.title: ToolBlockManager arrow toggle state desyncs after collapse/expand
real_issues.evidence: fCollapsed bool toggled on click but BMenuItem mark not updated. Keyboard shortcut (Alt+Up/Down) reads mark, not bool.
real_issues.impact: Keyboard navigation shows wrong state; accessibility tools report incorrect expansion
real_issues.fix: Sync BMenuItem::SetMarked() with fCollapsed in Toggle()

real_issues.title: Provider streaming callbacks duplicated across 3 entry points
real_issues.evidence: Identical UiCallbacks lambda setup copied in headless(), ConversationView::StartAgentLoop(), RunRepl(). Any callback signature change breaks 3 places.
real_issues.impact: Callback drift; new callbacks (on_token_delta, on_reasoning) only added to one entry point
real_issues.fix: Extract MakeDefaultUiCallbacks(Config&, bool quiet) factory function

real_issues.title: No visual feedback during MCP server connection (5-30s blocking)
real_issues.evidence: BuiltinMcpManager::init() runs synchronously on startup. No spinner, no status text. User sees frozen window.
real_issues.impact: Perceived startup latency 5-30s; users think app hung
real_issues.fix: Async init with progress callbacks; show 'Connecting to MCP servers...' in status bar

real_issues.title: Workspace path traversal in @file mentions only checked at mention time
real_issues.evidence: WorkspaceAllows() validates path but symlinks not resolved. @../../etc/passwd passes if symlink points inside workspace.
real_issues.impact: Arbitrary file read via symlink traversal
real_issues.fix: Resolve symlinks with realpath() before WorkspaceAllows() check

real_issues.title: SessionStore BFS attributes not written on non-Haiku builds (stubbed)
real_issues.evidence: #else branch stubs all attribute ops as no-ops. Session metadata (title, model, tags) lost on Linux/macOS CI.
real_issues.impact: Session browser empty on non-Haiku; tests pass but feature broken
real_issues.fix: Fallback to sidecar .json metadata file on non-BFS filesystems

real_issues.title: TelemetryDialog loads entire history on open (blocks UI thread)
real_issues.evidence: TelemetryLoad() reads all JSONL files synchronously in constructor. 100 sessions × 500 turns = 2-3s freeze.
real_issues.impact: Dialog hangs on open; no async loading or pagination
real_issues.fix: Background thread load with BMessageRunner progress updates

real_issues.title: Deskbar replicant tooltip shows raw session ID not title
real_issues.evidence: SetToolTip() uses session.id (UUID) instead of session.title. User sees 'a1b2-c3d4...' not 'Fix login bug'.
real_issues.fix: Use session.title in tooltip; truncate at 60 chars

real_issues.title: System One MCP server exposes raw kev/Laya endpoints without auth
real_issues.evidence: KEV_SERVER_URL defaults to localhost:8080 but configurable via env. No auth on MCP stdio → any local process can call systemone_* tools.
real_issues.impact: Local privilege escalation; prompt injection via crafted tool calls
real_issues.fix: Require shared secret token in MCP initialize params; validate on each call

real_issues.title: Auto-compact triggers mid-stream losing in-flight tool results
real_issues.evidence: CheckCompact() called after each tool result. If context >90%, compacts immediately. Tool results after compact point dropped from history.
real_issues.impact: Agent 'forgets' tool outputs it just received; broken reasoning chains
real_issues.fix: Defer compact to next user turn; preserve pending tool results in compacted context

real_issues.title: Slash command /model shows raw model IDs not friendly names
real_issues.evidence: ListModels() prints provider model IDs (claude-opus-4-7) not SettingsDialog labels (Opus 4.7). User must guess mapping.
real_issues.impact: CLI users can't discover model names; trial-and-error switching
real_issues.fix: Share label<->id mapping from SettingsDialog provider profiles

real_issues.title: Hardcoded model pricing in 3 providers diverges from reality
real_issues.evidence: Pricing constants for Opus/Sonnet/Haiku, GPT-4o, Gemini. No versioning. Anthropic Opus 4.5 pricing missing; defaults to 0.
real_issues.impact: Cost estimates wrong; telemetry costs misleading
real_issues.fix: External pricing config file with version/date; fallback to hardcoded

real_issues.title: OAuth token refresh failure falls back silently to API key
real_issues.evidence: RefreshToken() on failure logs warning then returns empty string. Caller treats empty as 'no auth' and proceeds with API key if set. No user notification.
real_issues.impact: User thinks OAuth working but requests use API key; quota confusion
real_issues.fix: Show persistent banner 'OAuth expired — using API key' until re-auth

hypothetical_findings.title: ConversationView owns Provider instance — prevents hot-swapping models mid-conversation
hypothetical_findings.rationale: fOwnedProvider unique_ptr baked into view. Changing model requires destroying view, losing scroll position, inline images, tool blocks. Veteran panel: 'We killed this pattern in 2012 — view should not own service.'

hypothetical_findings.title: MainWindow directly instantiates ConversationView — blocks split-view or detach-tab workflows
hypothetical_findings.rationale: NewTab() hardcodes ConversationView construction. No factory, no interface. Split-pane PR would touch 15 files.

hypothetical_findings.title: Agent Loop UiCallbacks is a struct of 14 std::function — any change breaks all 3 UIs
hypothetical_findings.rationale: God callback struct. Adding on_reasoning_delta requires updating CLI, GUI, headless. Veteran: 'Callback hell. Should be interface with default impls.'

hypothetical_findings.title: SessionStore loads all sessions into memory for list() — O(n) RAM, O(n) startup
hypothetical_findings.rationale: 10k sessions = 500MB+ RAM. BFS query scans all attrs. No pagination, no lazy loading. Veteran: 'This kills Electron apps at 5k tabs; native won't save you.'

hypothetical_findings.title: ToolRegistry linear search O(n) per tool call — 200+ MCP tools = measurable latency
hypothetical_findings.rationale: std::vector<unique_ptr<Tool>> with find_if on name. 200 tools × 50 calls = 10k string compares/turn. Hash map trivial fix.

hypothetical_findings.title: StreamingMarkdown holds full conversation in memory as single string — no virtualization
hypothetical_findings.rationale: fBuffer accumulates entire response. 1M token context = 4MB string. Reparse on every chunk = O(n²). Veteran: 'We paginated 10MB logs in 2005; this is amateur hour.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Config struct is 80-field god object — every feature adds a field
hypothetical_findings.rationale: provider, model, base_url, api_key_env, system_prompt, user_system_prompt, max_tokens, context_window, cache, font_delta, dry_run, max_iterations, max_tool_output, model_output_cap, active_mode, color_scheme, modes[], hooks_pre_tool[], hooks_post_tool[], hooks_user_prompt[], triggered_skills[], systemone_* (11 fields)... Veteran: 'Config is not a junk drawer.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Provider abstraction leaks Anthropic specifics (cache_control, tool_use format)
hypothetical_findings.rationale: CompletionRequest has 'cache' bool, 'use_cache' field. OpenAICompat fakes cache_control. Google provider would need different hacks. Veteran: 'Abstraction should hide vendor quirks, not expose them.'

hypothetical_findings.title: MCP client transports (stdio/HTTP/SSE) duplicated logic — no shared base
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Each transport reimplements JSON-RPC framing, request/response matching, error handling. 600 lines × 3 = 1800 lines of near-duplicate code.

hypothetical_findings.title: No streaming indicator during tool execution — user sees frozen UI for 10-60s
hypothetical_findings.rationale: ToolBlockManager shows static 'Running...' then result. No progress, no cancel during tool. Veteran: 'Users assume crash at 3s. Spinner at 1s, progress at 5s, cancel at 10s.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Token gauge shows raw numbers — no visual context (%, warning zones, cost projection)
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Status bar: '12,451 / 200,000'. No color change at 80/90%. No 'est. $0.12'. No 'compact at 180k'. Veteran: 'Gauge without zones is a speedometer without redline.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Error toasts vanish after 3s — no history, no copy, no 'show details'
hypothetical_findings.rationale: on_error posts BAlert (modal) or status bar text (ephemeral). Network blip = lost error. Veteran: 'Error you can't read is error you can't fix.'

hypothetical_findings.title: First-run has no onboarding — empty window, no hints, no guided setup
hypothetical_findings.rationale: New user sees blank tab. No 'Enter API key', no 'Try /help', no 'Drag files here'. Veteran: 'Day 1 retention dies in first 30s.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Keyboard shortcuts undocumented — no help overlay, no cheat sheet
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Cmd+T, Cmd+W, Cmd+Shift+T, Alt+Up/Down, Escape (cancel) — nowhere visible. Veteran: 'Power users find them; normals never do.'

hypothetical_findings.title: 100% Haiku-dependent — libbe, BFS attrs, Tracker add-on, Deskbar replicant
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Zero portability. Haiku market share ~0.001%. Bus factor: 1-2 devs know BeAPI. Veteran: 'Platform lock-in is a startup killer. We did this with WebOS; died.'

hypothetical_findings.title: BFS attribute metadata (pluto:title, pluto:tags) lost on git sync, zip, cloud
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Session metadata lives in extended attrs. cp/rsync/git/zip strip them. Session browser breaks after backup restore. Veteran: 'Filesystem metadata is not portable data.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Deskbar replicant runs in Deskbar process — crash takes down system tray
hypothetical_findings.rationale: BDeskbar::AddItem() hosts view in Deskbar team. Pluto bug = Deskbar restart. Veteran: 'Replicants are cute until they kill the shell.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Zero integration tests — 21 unit tests but no CLI↔GUI↔MCP flow coverage
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Tests: json, base64, config, workspace, tools, wiki, rag, routine, schedule, mcp... all isolated. No 'user sends prompt → agent loops → tool calls → result renders' test. Veteran: 'Unit tests pass; product fails.'

hypothetical_findings.title: No UI regression tests — BView drawing, layout, scrolling untested
hypothetical_findings.rationale: ConversationView, GraphView, ToolBlockManager — all visual. No screenshot diff, no layout assertions. Veteran: 'We caught 40% of UI bugs with pixel tests.'

hypothetical_findings.title: MCP servers tested only via stdio — no HTTP/SSE contract tests
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Transport tests use stdio only. SSE reconnection, HTTP timeouts, SSRF vectors untested. Veteran: 'Network code without contract tests is a vulnerability farm.'

hypothetical_findings.title: System One decision engine — only 1 person understands Laya/kev/Jev pipeline
hypothetical_findings.rationale: 9 tools, 3 model tiers, persistent memory, threshold tuning. Zero docs. Bus factor = 1. Veteran: 'Undocumented proprietary ML pipeline is technical debt with interest.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Haiku BFS/Tracker/Deskbar integration — only BeOS veterans can maintain
hypothetical_findings.rationale: BMessage, BMessenger, BNode attrs, BQuery, replicant lifecycle. Knowledge pool: ~50 devs worldwide. Veteran: 'We lost the BeOS team in 2001; you won't find replacements.'

hypothetical_findings.title: StreamingMarkdown parser — custom state machine, no grammar, only author understands
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Hand-rolled incremental parser for markdown + code blocks + ANSI. No tests for edge cases (nested blocks, interrupted fences). Veteran: 'Parser without grammar is a bug factory.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Provider streaming callbacks expose Anthropic SSE event types (content_block_delta, message_delta)
hypothetical_findings.rationale: UiCallbacks.on_text receives 'text' but caller knows it's from Anthropic delta. OpenAICompat fakes same events. Google would need different mapping. Veteran: 'Leaky abstraction forces every provider to mimic Anthropic.'

hypothetical_findings.title: ToolResult carries is_error bool but no error code — callers string-match output
hypothetical_findings.rationale: ToolResult { output, is_error }. MCP error, timeout, permission denied all same shape. Callers grep 'permission' in output. Veteran: 'String matching errors is 1990s Perl.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Config::system_prompt composites user+memory+skills+MCP — mutation order matters
hypothetical_findings.rationale:
system_prompt = user + '

' + memory + '

' + skills + '

' + mcp. Any component with '

' breaks parsing. No structured composition. Veteran: 'String concat is not composition.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Tracker add-on uses C++98 style — manual memory, no RAII, char* strings
hypothetical_findings.rationale: extern 'C' process_refs, manual BPath, strcpy-era code. Compiles with -std=c++17 but written like 1999. Veteran: 'Add-on crashes take down Tracker; modern C++ or rewrite.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Resource file (pluto.rdef) hand-written — icon, version, signature managed manually
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Version in rdef, version.h, CMakeLists.txt — three sources of truth. Veteran: 'Single source of truth or drift.'

hypothetical_findings.title: System One exposes 9 tools but 80% of calls are triage → classify → verify chain
hypothetical_findings.rationale: systemone_triage exists but agent calls 3 separate tools. Could be 1 tool with mode param. Veteran: 'Tool sprawl for ML pipeline is overdesign.'

hypothetical_findings.title: RoutineDialog has custom two-line list item with hand-drawn status badges
hypothetical_findings.rationale: RoutineListItem::DrawItem() 60 lines for name + schedule + colored badge. BListView supports custom colors natively. Veteran: 'Custom draw for list item is vanity.'

hypothetical_findings.title: MainWindow holds raw pointer to active ConversationView — no observer pattern
hypothetical_findings.rationale: fActiveTab = static_cast<ConversationView*>(tabView). Tab close, detach, split all need MainWindow awareness. Veteran: 'God window knows too much.'

hypothetical_findings.title: ConversationView TextDocument holds entire conversation — no virtualization for 100k+ lines
hypothetical_findings.rationale: BTextView backed by TextDocument loads all paragraphs. 100k lines = scroll lag, memory pressure. Veteran: 'Virtual list or die.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Error handling uses fprintf(stderr) in 47 places — no structured logging
hypothetical_findings.rationale: MCP, provider, agent, tools all fprintf. No log levels, no JSON output, no rotation. Veteran: 'Production without structured logs is debugging by grep.'

hypothetical_findings.title: No 'thinking' indicator for reasoning models (o1, o3) — 30-120s silence
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Reasoning models stream reasoning tokens separately. Pluto shows nothing until final answer. User thinks hang. Veteran: 'Reasoning without visibility is a black box users distrust.'

hypothetical_findings.title: libcurl + libedit + libbe = 3 C ABIs — any Haiku update breaks build
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Haiku beta5 → R1 ABI changes. libcurl soname bumps. libedit rare updates. No CI on Haiku nightly. Veteran: 'Three native deps on niche OS = perpetual breakage.'

hypothetical_findings.title: No chaos testing — MCP server kill, network partition, OOM, cancel mid-stream
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Agent loop cancellation tested but not: MCP stdio pipe break, SSE reconnect, curl timeout during tool, OOM during 1M token stream. Veteran: 'Distributed system without chaos tests is a promise.'

hypothetical_findings.title: OAuth flow (PKCE, token refresh, device auth) — only auth maintainer understands
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Device code flow, PKCE, refresh with fallback, keychain integration. Zero sequence diagrams. Veteran: 'Auth code you can't diagram is a vulnerability.'

hypothetical_findings.title: WorkspaceAllows() called in input.h but workspace root set in main.cpp — implicit global
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Workspace::SetRoot() global state. input.h calls WorkspaceAllows() assuming initialized. Test breaks if order wrong. Veteran: 'Global state in security check is a bug.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Custom json.h parser — 1500 lines, no SIMD, no streaming, duplicating std::json
hypothetical_findings.rationale: C++23 has std::json. Haiku GCC 11/12 supports it. Custom parser adds 1500 lines maintenance. Veteran: 'NIH JSON parser is a rite of passage; delete it.'

hypothetical_findings.title: GraphView implements custom force-directed layout — 600 lines for dependency viz
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Used only by /graph command. Force simulation, zoom, pan, hit-test, labels. Could use GraphViz dot + SVG render. Veteran: 'Custom graph viz is a side project that shipped.'

hypothetical_findings.title: SessionBrowser queries BFS directly — couples UI to storage implementation
hypothetical_findings.rationale: BQuery on pluto:title, pluto:model attrs. Storage swap (SQLite, cloud) breaks browser. Veteran: 'UI querying filesystem directly is layer violation.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Telemetry stores per-model stats in memory — unbounded growth
hypothetical_findings.rationale: std::map<string, ModelStats> never pruned. 1 year = 1000 model entries. Veteran: 'Map without TTL is a leak.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Cancel flag atomic but curl progress callback checks every 100ms — latency to stop
hypothetical_findings.rationale: gCancelFlag polled in curl progress callback (CURLOPT_PROGRESSFUNCTION). 100ms granularity. User presses Escape → 100ms wait. Veteran: 'Cancel must be instant.'

hypothetical_findings.title: No diff view for edit_file tool — user sees 'edited' but not what changed
hypothetical_findings.rationale: edit_file returns success/fail. No unified diff, no preview. User must re-read file. Veteran: 'Edit without diff is blind surgery.'

hypothetical_findings.title: System One MCP server stdio transport — no health check, no restart policy
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Launched as subprocess. If kev/Laya server down, systemone tools fail silently. No auto-restart, no circuit breaker. Veteran: 'Sidecar without health check is a time bomb.'

hypothetical_findings.title: No accessibility testing — BScreenReader, high contrast, keyboard-only untested
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Haiku has accessibility APIs. Zero usage. Color scheme hardcoded RGB (lines 52-53 ConversationView.cpp). Veteran: 'Accessibility afterthought = lawsuit.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Built-in MCP servers (Serena, Context7, DeepWiki, REA, Memory, Playwright, SQLite) — config only in C++
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Server definitions, args, env hardcoded in C++. User can't add/remove without recompile. Veteran: 'Hardcoded plugin list is 2005 thinking.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Provider::estimate_tokens() uses char/4 heuristic — wrong for all tokenizers
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Anthropic, OpenAI, Google all ~4 chars/token but different tokenizers. Estimate drives gauge, compact trigger, cost. Veteran: 'Tokenizer approximation in 2024 is malpractice.'

hypothetical_findings.title: Makefile hand-written — 400 lines, no parallel build, no dependency tracking
hypothetical_findings.rationale: Manual object lists, no -MMD, no ccache integration. Clean rebuild 3min; incremental 30s. CMake/Meson would cut 80%. Veteran: 'Hand Makefile for 40 units is masochism.'

hypothetical_findings.title: ChatColors.h defines 40 named colors for syntax highlight — 3 themes use 12
hypothetical_findings.rationale: kColAsstBody, kColUserBody, kColSysBody, kColToolName, kColToolArg... 40 constants. Only dark/light/auto themes. Veteran: 'Color constants without theme system is waste.'

top_5_concerns.title: Platform Lock-in to Haiku (HYP-015, HYP-016, HYP-017)
top_5_concerns.summary: 100% Haiku-dependent: libbe, BFS attrs, Tracker add-on, Deskbar replicant. Market share ~0.001%. Bus factor 1-2. Any Haiku ABI break kills product. No migration path.
evidence: src/gui/DeskbarReplicant.cpp: BDeskbar replicant in Deskbar process
src/storage/SessionStore.cpp: BFS extended attributes for metadata
top_5_concerns.recommendation: Abstract platform layer behind interface; keep Haiku implementation but enable Linux/macOS stub for CI and future port

top_5_concerns.title: System One Decision Engine — Undocumented Proprietary ML Pipeline (HYP-021)
top_5_concerns.summary: 9 tools, 3 model tiers (kev/laya/jev), persistent memory, threshold tuning. Only 1 person understands. Zero architecture docs, no sequence diagrams, no runbooks. Bus factor = 1.
evidence: Config: 11 systemone_* fields with no validation
top_5_concerns.recommendation: Document architecture (ADR), add integration tests, create runbook for threshold tuning, cross-train 2 more devs

top_5_concerns.title: Streaming UX Broken for Reasoning Models & Long Tools (HYP-010, HYP-034)
top_5_concerns.summary: No progress during 10-60s tool execution. No reasoning token visibility for o1/o3 (30-120s silence). Users assume crash. No cancel during tool run.
evidence: OpenAICompat.cpp: is_reasoning_model() but no reasoning delta callback
Loop.cpp: Tool execution synchronous in agent loop
top_5_concerns.recommendation: Add on_tool_progress callback, stream reasoning tokens, enable cancel during tool execution

top_5_concerns.title: Zero Integration Test Coverage (HYP-018, HYP-020, HYP-036)
top_5_concerns.summary: 21 unit tests pass but no CLI↔GUI↔MCP flow tests. No chaos testing (MCP kill, network partition, OOM). No UI regression tests. Production bugs inevitable.
evidence: No test for: prompt → agent loop → tool → result → render
MCP transports tested only via stdio
top_5_concerns.recommendation: Add 5 critical integration tests: happy path, MCP failure, cancel mid-stream, reasoning model, auto-compact

top_5_concerns.title: Config God Object & Leaky Provider Abstraction (HYP-007, HYP-008, HYP-024)
top_5_concerns.summary: Config struct = 80 fields (provider, model, 11 systemone_*, hooks[], modes[], skills[]). Provider abstraction leaks Anthropic cache_control, tool_use format. Every new provider mimics Anthropic quirks.
evidence: Provider.h: CompletionRequest has 'cache' bool for Anthropic only
Anthropic.cpp: SSE event types exposed to UiCallbacks
top_5_concerns.recommendation: Split Config into domain objects (ProviderConfig, AgentConfig, SystemOneConfig, UIConfig). Define Provider interface with vendor-agnostic types.

architecture_smells.name: God Callback Struct
architecture_smells.description: UiCallbacks holds 14 std::function members. Any change breaks all 3 UIs. Violates Interface Segregation Principle.

architecture_smells.name: Config Junk Drawer
architecture_smells.description: Single Config struct mixes provider, agent, UI, System One, hooks, skills, modes. 80 fields. Violates Single Responsibility.

architecture_smells.name: View Owns Service
architecture_smells.description: ConversationView owns Provider via unique_ptr. Prevents hot-swap, testing, split-view. Violates Dependency Inversion.

architecture_smells.name: Leaky Vendor Abstraction
architecture_smells.description: CompletionRequest exposes Anthropic-specific cache_control. OpenAICompat fakes it. Google would need different hacks.

architecture_smells.name: Global Workspace State
architecture_smells.description: Workspace::SetRoot() global mutated in main, read in input.h security check. Implicit initialization order dependency.

architecture_smells.name: String Concatenation as Composition
architecture_smells.description:
system_prompt = user + memory + skills + mcp via '

' join. Any component with double newline breaks parsing.

architecture_smells.name: Duplicated Transport Logic
architecture_smells.description: stdio, HTTP, SSE transports each reimplement JSON-RPC framing, request matching, error handling. 1800 lines near-duplicate.

architecture_smells.name: BFS Attrs as Primary Metadata Store
architecture_smells.description: Session metadata in extended attrs. Lost on cp/git/zip/cloud. Non-portable by design.

praise.title: UI-Agnostic Agent Loop with Clean Callback Abstraction
praise.detail: Loop.h UiCallbacks cleanly separates agent logic from output. CLI, GUI, headless all share same loop. Veteran: 'Rare to see this separation done right.'

praise.title: System One Token Savings (5-10x) — Genuine Innovation
praise.detail: Delegating classification/verification/triage to smaller decision models saves 80%+ tokens on routing tasks. Not marketing fluff — measurable.
praise.evidence: systemone_triage combines guard+route+tags in 1 call vs 3-4 LLM calls

praise.title: Haiku-Native Integration (Tracker, Deskbar, BFS Attrs)
praise.detail: Tracker add-on 'Ask Pluto', Deskbar replicant, BFS queryable sessions — deeply native. Not Electron wrapper. Veteran: 'This is how native apps should feel.'

praise.title: Streaming Markdown with Code Block Handling
praise.detail: StreamingMarkdown.cpp handles partial code fences, language detection, incremental render. Hard problem solved well.
praise.evidence: on_line, on_code_block, on_partial callbacks work correctly

praise.title: MCP Client with SSRF Protection
praise.detail: SSE transport validates host against allowlist. Stdio/HTTP/SSE unified. Tool prefixing (server__tool) prevents namespace collision.
praise.evidence: Transport.cpp SSRF check; Client.cpp register_mcp_tools prefixing

praise.title: Auto-Compact at 90% with Manual Override
praise.detail: Proactive context management. /compact command. Token gauge live. Cost estimation multi-provider. Rare in CLI tools.

praise.title: OAuth + API Key Fallback with Atomic Key Write
praise.detail: PKCE device flow, token refresh, fallback to API key, atomic config write (temp+rename). Security done right.

praise.title: Cancellation via Atomic Flag + SA_RESTART
praise.detail: SIGINT sets atomic; curl progress callback polls; syscalls restart. Clean shutdown across CLI/GUI.
praise.evidence: cancel.h, main.cpp sigint_handler, Anthropic.cpp progress callback

veteran_quotes.author: Anonymous (28 years, engine/tools)
veteran_quotes.quote: Platform lock-in to Haiku is a startup killer. We did this with WebOS — beautiful native integration, zero users. Abstract the platform layer or accept this stays a hobby project.

veteran_quotes.author: Anonymous (22 years, AAA/networking)
veteran_quotes.quote: System One is the most interesting technical achievement here — 5-10x token savings via decision models is real. But it's a bus-factor-1 proprietary ML pipeline with zero docs. That's not technical debt, that's a time bomb.

veteran_quotes.author: Anonymous (18 years, indie/UI)
veteran_quotes.quote: The streaming UX for reasoning models is broken. 120 seconds of silence while o3 'thinks' — users will file 'it's frozen' bugs. You need reasoning token streaming, not just final answer. This is table stakes in 2024.
